ex.s: These two pieces of information - the time of day and the point where the sun is in the sky - allow the butterfly to determine the way to go.
ex.t: 这两个信息--一天中的时间和太阳在天空中的位置--让蝴蝶决定前进的方向。

ex.s: We could also say The butterfly is aware of the time of day and the position of the sun in the sky, so it can use these two pieces of information to find out which way to go.
ex.t: 我们也可以说，蝴蝶能察觉一天中的时间和太阳在天空中的位置，从而利用这两点信息来判断该往哪个方向飞。
